intentional_wire_correction: Room packet ID initialized to 0x00d7; unused fixed-name bytes zeroed instead of copying inline-string metadata. Replay consumers retain the same text and dispatch by the enclosing tags.
text_padding: The archived writer uses the real std_string_copy implementation for names. Short store-assistant names therefore include the old size/capacity bytes; comparison preserves every name byte and normalizes only bytes after its first NUL.
